use default

union Tree is
    LEAF(value: int)
    NEST(children: LIST[Tree])
si

nest(levels: int[]) -> Tree is
    let root = LIST()
    let open = LIST([root])

    for level in levels do
        while open.count < level do
            let deeper = LIST()

            open[open.count - 1].add(Tree.NEST(deeper))
            open.add(deeper)
        od

        while open.count > level do
            open.remove_at(open.count - 1)
        od

        open[open.count - 1].add(Tree.LEAF(level))
    od

    Tree.NEST(root)
si

render(tree: Tree) -> string =>
    case tree
    when leaf: Tree.LEAF then
        "{leaf.value}"
    when nest: Tree.NEST then
        "[{nest.children |> map(render) |> join(", ")}]"
    esac

let inputs = [
    [],
    [1, 2, 4],
    [3, 1, 3, 1],

    [3, 3, 3, 1, 1, 3, 3, 3]]

inputs
